{
  "phoneNote": "The food photo and warm typography suit the gostilna, but widely separated, equally styled action links make the first screen feel unnecessarily stretched.",
  "desktopNote": "The photographic hero feels welcoming and composed, but the narrow menu and opening-hours layouts leave large unused areas on the right.",

    "impression": 4,

    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 4,

    "clutter": 4,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "On phone, give the call action a filled button treatment, keep directions as a compact secondary link, and reduce the large vertical gaps between them.",
    "Use two desktop columns for the menu categories and integrate opening hours into a balanced practical-information layout rather than leaving most of that section empty.",
    "Bring the existing Kamnik location into the hero and reduce the oversized footer wordmark so useful location and contact information takes precedence."
  ],
  "blockers": []
}
